module: Orchestrator of mission start and stop. Each start or stop is a sequence of steps (taskData.steps) executed frame by frame in onUpdate: screen fade, removal/stashing of vehicles, creation of the mission vehicle, traffic, environment configuration (time, clouds, wind, fog), then mission:onStart(). Stopping restores the vehicles, traffic and environment. Only one "foreground" mission can run at a time. A modder calls it to start or stop a mission from code.
notes: The start and stop functions return true on error (mission nil, already running, not running) and nil if a task is already active (simple warning in the log); a new start or stop is refused as long as taskData.active is true (see isCurrentlyProcessingStep).
Each step has a timeout (120 s by default, 10 s for the start fade, 5 s for the end fade); after this delay it is marked finished with an error in the log.

In taskStartMissionStep, if mission:onStart() returns a truthy value, _isOngoing is set back to false and an error is logged, but execution continues: foregroundMissionId is still set (unless mission.background) and the onAnyMissionChanged("started") hook is emitted.
Hook onAnyMissionChanged: ("started", mission, userSettings, startedFrom) on start; ("stopped", mission) on stop. onAnyMissionWillChange: ("stopped", mission, abandoned) just before the actual stop.

The environment is only modified if mission.setupModules.environment.enabled; the original values (time, clouds, cloud wind, fog) are saved in setupModules.environment._original* to be restored. The wind applied to vehicles is _windVec = (sin(windDirAngle), cos(windDirAngle), 0) * windSpeed.

Stashed vehicles can be removed then recreated from their spawn data (despawnStashedVehiclesForMission=true); in career, a vehicle that is too damaged is put in the inventory and is not respawned ("vehStoredMission" toast).
startInstant has no nil mission check, no "already running" guard, and no "active task" guard, unlike startWithFade / startAsScenario.
allowMissionInteraction is a WIP: returns false if core_gamestate.state.state is not "freeroam", true otherwise (the call in onUpdate is commented out).
This module's onUpdate hook calls mission:onUpdate for all _isOngoing missions, only when a foreground mission exists, iterating over gameplay_missions_missions.getAllMissions().

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded beforehand: gameplay_traffic, gameplay_police, gameplay_parking, ui_fadeScreen.

fadeDuration.desc: Duration (s) of the screen fade, 0.75 by default; used for the start fade in startFromWithinMission.

start.desc: Alias of startWithFade: starts a mission with a screen fade.

startWithFade.desc: Starts a mission with the full sequence of steps: fade, vehicle removal, preparation (pre-mission), starting repair, snapshot of part condition (except skipPartConditionSnapshot), vehicle stashing, mission vehicle, traffic, then onStart. Emits the hook onMissionStartWithFade(mission, userSettings).

returns.desc: true on error (mission nil or already running), nil if a task is already active.

startAsScenario.desc: Starts a mission without fade or vehicle removal: pre-mission, vehicle stashing, vehicle, traffic, onStart (used when the mission is launched as a scenario).

returns.desc: true on error, nil if a task is active.

startFromWithinMission.desc: Stops the foreground mission then starts another (or the same, reconfigured): with a fade (default) or instantly. The actual start is deferred until the stop finishes (handled in onUpdate). Emits onMissionReconfigured if it is the same mission.

startInstant.desc: Starts a mission immediately with only the pre-mission and onStart steps (without touching vehicles). Emits the hook startFromWithinMissionInstant(mission, userSettings, startingOptions).

startWithLoadingLevel.desc: First loads the level (the mission's by default), stops any foreground mission, then runs pre-mission, vehicle stashing, vehicle, traffic and onStart.

level.desc: Level to load; mission.startTrigger.level by default.

startedFrom.desc: Origin of the start (passed to the hooks).

stop.desc: Stops a running mission: the mission's onStop, restoration of stashed vehicles, post-processing, vehicle removal, respawn of the player's vehicle and traffic, then fade (unless data.ignoreFade). Emits the hook onMissionStopped(mission).

data.desc: Stop data: ignoreFade, abandoned, attempt, stopInstant...

returns.desc: true on error (mission nil or not running), nil if a task is active.

attemptAbandonMissionWithFade.desc: Requests the abandonment of a mission. Emits onGameplayActivityAborted (if abandonButtonPressed) then onMissionAbandoned(mission, abandonButtonPressed). If the mission handles abandonment itself (mission:attemptAbandonMission() true, e.g. a flowgraph with onRequestAbandon), stops there; otherwise launches the stop sequence with fade.

abandonButtonPressed.desc: true if the player pressed the abandon button (data.abandoned = true).

returns.desc: true on error or if the mission handles abandonment itself.

stopForegroundMissionInstantly.desc: Immediately stops the foreground mission (taskStopMissionStep with stopInstant) without restoring vehicles or environment. Also called at the end of a level load and on career activation.

allowMissionInteraction.desc: WIP: indicates whether interaction with missions is allowed (true only if the game state is "freeroam").

getForegroundMissionId.desc: Id of the current foreground mission (exclusive: only one at a time), or nil.

isCurrentlyProcessingStep.desc: Returns whether a start/stop sequence of steps is currently being processed.

getCurrentTaskdataTypeOrNil.desc: Returns the type of the current task ("start" or "stop"), "start" also if a start from within a mission is deferred, nil if no task.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame. Advances the steps of the active task (timeouts included), launches the deferred start of startFromWithinMission when the stop is finished, and calls mission:onUpdate of the running missions. Contains an imgui debug window (disabled by default).

onScreenFadeState.desc: ui_fadeScreen hook called at each phase of the fade. Unblocks the step waiting for the fade (fadeState<state> = true) and triggers the stop of the current mission for a deferred start.

onTrafficStarted.desc: Hook called when traffic starts: validates the step waiting for traffic (waitForTraffic).

onParkingVehiclesActivated.desc: Hook called when parked vehicles appear without traffic: same effect as onTrafficStarted.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of the current level (level change): immediately stops the foreground mission without cleanup (alias of stopForegroundMissionInstantly). Unrelated to the end of a gameplay mission.

onCareerActive.desc: Hook called on career activation: immediately stops the foreground mission (alias of stopForegroundMissionInstantly).
